# Create payment requests for taxi to each roommate (Jordan, Kathryn, Nancy) for $15 each
# and a payment to Nancy for food $32.

# Taxi requests
for email in ['jo-harr@gmail.com', 'kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com', 'nan_ritt@gmail.com']:
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        user_email=email,
        amount=15,
        description='For Taxi'
    )
    print(email, result)

# Payment to Nancy for food
food_payment = apis.venmo.create_transaction(
    access_token=venmo_token,
    receiver_email='nan_ritt@gmail.com',
    amount=32,
    description='For Food'
)
print('Food payment:', food_payment)
